questions.question: Which products cost more than $500?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE CAST(replace(price, '$', '') AS INTEGER) > 500
questions.note: Prices are text with a dollar sign in products.csv ('$1289').

questions.question: Which products cost between $200 and $250?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE CAST(replace(price, '$', '') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 200 AND 250
questions.note: Two products share the price $212.

questions.question: Which suppliers specialize in foam?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE specialty = 'Foam'

questions.question: Which supplier is based in São Paulo?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM suppliers WHERE city = 'São Paulo'

questions.question: Which parts does Shanghai Metal Corp supply with a lead time of less than 10 days?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT part_name FROM part_supplier_mapping WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-002' AND lead_time_days < 10
questions.note: Part names, not part ids: one part name can stand for parts of several products.

questions.question: Which parts does some supplier offer at a unit cost above $45?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT part_name FROM part_supplier_mapping WHERE CAST(replace(unit_cost, '$', '') AS DOUBLE) > 45
questions.note: Unit costs are text with a dollar sign ('$42.73').

questions.question: Which suppliers ask for a minimum order of more than 90 units for at least one part?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM part_supplier_mapping m JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE m.minimum_order_quantity > 90
questions.note: Names as suppliers.csv writes them (the mapping writes 'nordic Wood Industries').

questions.question: Which components does the Uppsala Sofa's assembly need more than two of?
questions.sql: SELECT a.component_name FROM assemblies a JOIN products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Uppsala Sofa' AND a.quantity > 2

questions.question: Which parts of the Linköping Bed's headboard are needed more than once?
questions.sql: SELECT c.part_name FROM components c JOIN assemblies a ON a.assembly_id = c.assembly_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Linköping Bed' AND a.component_name = 'Headboard' AND c.quantity > 1

questions.question: For which parts of the Helsingborg Dresser's drawers does the other supplier quote a shorter lead time than the preferred supplier?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.part_name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping pref ON pref.part_id = c.part_id AND pref.preferred_supplier JOIN part_supplier_mapping other ON other.part_id = c.part_id AND NOT other.preferred_supplier WHERE p.product_name = 'Helsingborg Dresser' AND a.component_name = 'Drawers' AND other.lead_time_days < pref.lead_time_days
questions.note: Every part has exactly two suppliers, one of them preferred.

questions.question: Which product is the most expensive?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name FROM products ORDER BY CAST(replace(price, '$', '') AS INTEGER) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Uppsala Sofa $1289, Linköping Bed $790.

questions.question: Which product is the cheapest?
questions.sql: SELECT product_name FROM products ORDER BY CAST(replace(price, '$', '') AS INTEGER) LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many products cost less than $250?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE CAST(replace(price, '$', '') AS INTEGER) < 250

questions.question: Which product's assembly needs the most screws?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM assemblies a JOIN products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id WHERE a.component_name = 'Screws' ORDER BY a.quantity DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Counts the Screws line of each product's assembly (Helsingborg 36, Västerås 30), not the screws of sub-assemblies.

questions.question: Which product's assembly lists the most components?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM assemblies a JOIN products p ON p.product_id = a.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Assembly lines per product: Norrköping Nightstand 9, Helsingborg Dresser 8.

questions.question: How many products include an Allen key in their assembly?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_id) FROM assemblies WHERE component_name = 'Allen Key'
questions.note: The Uppsala Sofa and the Örebro Lamp have none.

questions.question: Which supplier is the preferred supplier for the most parts?
questions.sql: SELECT s.name FROM part_supplier_mapping m JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE m.preferred_supplier GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY count(DISTINCT m.part_id) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Counted by part id.

questions.question: How many parts does Korean Metal Works supply?
questions.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT part_id) FROM part_supplier_mapping WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-012'
questions.note: Counted by part id.

questions.question: What is the longest lead time in days that any supplier quotes for a part?
questions.sql: SELECT max(lead_time_days) FROM part_supplier_mapping

questions.question: How many suppliers in the data supply no parts at all?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM suppliers s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM part_supplier_mapping m WHERE m.supplier_id = s.supplier_id)
questions.note: The two electronics and the two packaging suppliers appear in no part's supply.

questions.question: Which suppliers provide the parts of the Linköping Bed's headboard?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Linköping Bed' AND a.component_name = 'Headboard'

questions.question: Which products contain foam padding?
